answer: Plates follow the state that issued them, not the state you live in, so your California plates need to come off the car. You must return them to the California motor vehicle agency within 10 days, and we'll give you the plate return receipt, form NW-PLT-1, which shows the car was sold. Also note that when selling at a North Carolina store, a car registered in another state needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station first, and you should bring your California registration.
